sources.facts: IntrepidManager 0.0.4 and later (/im facts), run in the Forever beta on 2026-10-21 on a Windows PC (build 70450). The game listed the methods of each widget type (Frame, Button, CheckButton, EditBox, ScrollFrame, Slider, StatusBar, FontString, Texture), and the facts run created fonts and templates and said whether the game accepted them.
sources.fl: ForeverLoot 1.0.2 (MIT, interface 16001, by Zerpy), an addon written for the Forever client. Its shipped code uses the name, so the name very likely exists. Nothing proves that code path ran, and nothing here says how the arguments work.
sources.probe: IntrepidProbe 0.5 to 0.6.3, run in the Forever beta on 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-20 on a Mac and a Windows PC. Its saved results say the name exists (a function, a table, a template that CreateFrame accepted) or not.
sources.selftest: IntrepidManager 0.0.2 and 0.0.3 (/im selftest), run in the Forever beta on the same days. The saved result shows the call worked; its chat output was read by the person who ran it.

events.ADDON_ACTION_BLOCKED: the probe registered it for /ip give but nothing was ever blocked, so it was never seen to fire; the trade code listens for it to tell a refused call from a quiet failure
events.ADDON_ACTION_FORBIDDEN: the probe registered it for /ip give but nothing was ever blocked, so it was never seen to fire; the trade code listens for it to tell a refused call from a quiet failure
events.INSPECT_READY: Blizzard's inspect event (it comes after NotifyInspect); not in any probe or self-test result, so it is used only by /im inspect, a test build
events.PLAYER_TARGET_CHANGED: The drop log (game/DropWatch.lua) reads the targeted creature's name and classification. A Blizzard event; not in any probe or self-test result yet.
events.UNIT_SPELLCAST_SUCCEEDED: The drop log (game/DropWatch.lua) listens for the player's own casts (RegisterUnitEvent on player) to leave out the loot window of Skinning, Mining, Herb Gathering and Pick Pocket. A Blizzard event; not in any probe or self-test result yet (stats.gatherWindows shows it working).
events.UPDATE_MOUSEOVER_UNIT: The drop log (game/DropWatch.lua) reads the creature under the mouse: its name and classification. A Blizzard event; not in any probe or self-test result yet.

globals.C_ChallengeMode: ForeverLoot only calls it behind an existence check, so its use shows nothing about whether the client has it.
globals.C_Spell: The drop log names the player's cast to tell a gathering spell (game/DropWatch.lua). Modern clients have C_Spell.GetSpellName; checked before use, with GetSpellInfo as the fallback. Not probed yet.
globals.ForeverDungeonJournal_NS: Set by the optional addon DungeonJournal (folder ForeverDungeonJournal, Core/Bootstrap.lua) when the player has it installed; read on the loot owner's copy, 2026-11-12. /im dj records whether it is there. Read only, every read guarded.
globals.GetAddOnMetadata: ForeverLoot only reaches it as a fallback after C_AddOns.GetAddOnMetadata. The probe saw C_AddOns.GetAddOnMetadata and found the old AddOn globals missing (GetAddOnInfo, GetNumAddOns, IsAddOnLoaded), so this one is probably missing too. Harmless as a fallback; remove it or test it.

globals.UnitClassification: The drop log (game/DropWatch.lua) asks it whether a creature under the mouse or targeted is rare (rare, rareelite). Not in any probe or self-test result yet: a dungeon run with the drop log answers it (stats.raresSeen).

methods.SetInventoryItem: Blizzard's GameTooltip method for an equipped item; not in any result yet. /im facts calls it on the tooltip and records what the tooltip then holds, so the next run settles it

C_ChallengeMode.IsChallengeModeActive: ForeverLoot only calls it behind an existence check (C_ChallengeMode and C_ChallengeMode.IsChallengeModeActive()), so its use shows nothing about whether the client has it.

C_Spell.GetSpellName: The name of a spell, for the drop log's gathering check (game/DropWatch.lua). Not probed yet; GetSpellInfo is the fallback.
